item.title: Security deposit in lease agreement not “debt” under RDDBFI Act: Punjab and Haryana High Court
item.description: “Once security deposit does not fall within the purview of Section 2(g) of the Recovery of Debts due to the Banks and Financial Institution Act, 1993 defining “debt”, the Tribunal would have no jurisdiction, as per Section 17 of the same Act.” The post Security deposit in lease agreement not “debt” under RDDBFI Act: Punjab and Haryana High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: Remand after reversal of Rejection of Plaint creates entitlement to refund of Court fees: Delhi High Court
item.description: “Order XLI Rule 23 of the CPC envisages remand in a situation in which the suit was decreed by the Court of first instance on a preliminary point and the decree is reversed in appeal by the appellate court.” The post Remand after reversal of Rejection of Plaint creates entitlement to refund of Court fees: Delhi High Court appeared first on SCC Times.

item.title: “How can a tenant claim a shop for life?”: Madhya Pradesh HC upholds 90-year-old shopkeeper’s eviction for expansion of landlord’s son’s shop
item.description: The Court stated that the appellant was 90 years old, and it was difficult to accept that he would be effectively running his business. It was fairly conceded by him that he had children, and he did not file any document to show that he was purchasing any goods from anybody to sell them at his shop. The post “How can a tenant claim a shop for life?”: Madhya Pradesh HC upholds 90-year-old shopkeeper’s eviction for expansion of landlord’s son’s shop appeared first on SCC Times.
